jj.badge.divergentTip: This change id names more than one commit: refer to this one by its commit id. Combwork never picks one.
jj.bookmarks.name: Bookmark
jj.bookmarks.note: Bookmarks are created, moved and pushed with jj itself: Combwork only shows them.
jj.compare.ambiguous: {rev} names {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}}: pick one by its commit id.
jj.compare.bad: Type a bookmark, a change id or a commit id.
jj.compare.capped: The diff is long: only its start is shown.
jj.compare.files: {n, plural, =0 {No files changed} one {# file changed} other {# files changed}}
jj.conflicts.files: {n, plural, one {# conflicted file} other {# conflicted files}}
jj.conflicts.intro: jj can keep a conflict in a commit and carry on. These commits store conflicts; resolve them with jj in a terminal (jj resolve).
jj.history.capped: Only the latest {n, number} are shown.
jj.integrate.head: Waiting for you to integrate
jj.integrate.how: For example, then move {target} to the rebased commit with jj bookmark set:
jj.integrate.noMerge: Combwork doesn’t merge under jj: integrate the reviewed work with jj yourself.
jj.repo.colocated: {colocated, select, yes {Colocated with Git: Git sees the same history.} other {Not colocated with Git.}}
jj.repo.edits: jj has no uncommitted changes: edits are recorded in the working-copy commit when jj snapshots them.
jj.repo.unsupported: Not supported with jj in Combwork
jj.unknown.heads: jj’s operation log has {detail} heads: Combwork reads nothing until jj reconciles them (any jj command in a terminal does).
jj.unknown.moved: The repository changed while it was read: refresh to read it again.
jj.unknown.noRepo: No jj repository was found here.
jj.unknown.tool: jj isn’t installed, or isn’t the version Combwork is tested with, so nothing is read through it.
